changes.comment: Final pass (R53): widened OpenRound.threadId to `string | undefined` to match FeishuSentMessage.threadId under exactOptionalPropertyTypes, and dropped FeishuSession.toolSession()'s unused caller parameter (the R41 Collaboration-Space guard ended up threading through sendText's own options instead) along with its one call site.
